04 / THE EXPERIMENT

Small model.
Clear boundaries.

This is a learning project about image classification, not a diagnostic tool. The task predicts dataset labels on downsampled pediatric images.

Explore the code ↗
Data & preprocessing

Official PneumoniaMNIST: 4,708 training, 524 validation, and 624 test images. Native 28 × 28 grayscale images; no additional resizing. Intensities are normalized to [−1, 1]. No augmentation or external data.

Training & model selection

Three 3 × 3 convolution blocks (8, 16, 24 channels), two max-pool stages, global average pooling, and one output. AdamW; class-weighted binary cross-entropy; seed 42. Checkpoint selected by validation AUC; threshold selected by validation balanced accuracy. One run, not a multi-seed benchmark.

Evaluation & limitations

All headline metrics use the full test set. The gallery deliberately includes errors. Image-level bootstrap intervals describe sampling variability; they do not account for patient clustering. No external validation, adult validation, calibration study, or clinical deployment. A feature map shows an activation—not a verified lesion.

Browser inference & reproducibility

The browser performs the same convolution, ReLU, pooling, and dense operations using exported trained weights. Predictions are checked against PyTorch and an ONNX export. No images are uploaded. Runtime depends on your device and excludes model download.
